tasks.title: The Mirror Test
paras: Very young children cannot recognize themselves in a mirror; they usually achieve this milestone around 18 months of age. The ability to recognize oneself in the mirror is considered to be a key component of self- awareness and consciousness for humans. But what about animals?

For many years, scientists have known that members of the great ape family could recognize themselves in mirrors. They measured this by the “mirror test,” which involved putting a colored mark on an ape’s body, and then showing the ape its reflection in a mirror. If the ape tried to remove the mark on its own body, the scientists knew that the ape was recognizing its reflection.

Apes are close relatives of humans, but in recent years, scientists have discovered that other animals also pass the “mirror test.” Elephants and dolphins have shown signs of self- recognition. These, like apes, are highly intelligent animals. But in a more recent experiment, a type of fish called the cleaner fish tried to scrape a mark off its body when it saw itself in the mirror. This suggests that even less intelligent animals may possess more self- awareness than previously suspected.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.C: Differences between apes, elephants, and dolphins

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 主旨题 原文定位（全文核心）： 文章开篇以人类幼儿镜像识别能力引入，随后重点围绕 “镜像测试” 展开，介绍科学家对类人猿、大象、海豚以及清洁鱼的研究，探讨动物的自我意识（认知能力）。 正确答案分析： 全文核心围绕科学家通过镜像测试，对不同动物的自我识别能力（属于认知范畴）进行研究，因此主旨是 “动物认知研究”，选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) Stages of early childhood development —— 错误，人类幼儿镜像识别仅为开篇引入，并非文章主要内容。 (B) Research on animal cognition —— 正确，符合全文围绕动物自我意识（认知能力）展开研究的核心。 (C) Differences between apes, elephants, and dolphins —— 错误，文中未对比三者的差异，而是强调它们均能通过镜像测试、具有自我识别能力。 (D) Recent experiments on fish —— 错误，清洁鱼的实验仅为文末补充，是研究的一部分，并非全文主旨。

questions.stem: The word “milestone” in the first sentence is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型： 词汇题 原文定位： “Very young children cannot recognize themselves in a mirror; they usually achieve this milestone around 18 months of age.” 正确答案分析： “milestone” 意为 “里程碑、重要成就”，在上下文中，幼儿约 18 个月能在镜子中认出自己，这是其成长过程中一个重要的发展节点，即一项重要成就。因此 “accomplishment”（成就）是最接近的含义。 选项分析： (A) accomplishment 成就 —— 正确，与 milestone 语义一致，符合 “幼儿达成镜像识别能力” 这一语境。 (B) distance 距离 —— 无关，与 “成长节点、成就” 无关联。 (C) weight 重量 —— 无关，语义不相关。 (D) discovery 发现 —— 错误，镜像识别是幼儿自身发展达成的能力，并非 “发现”。

questions.stem: Why did scientists put colored marks on animals’ bodies?

options.A: It made it possible to track the animals’ movements.
options.B: It helped them determine whether the animals recognized themselves.
options.C: It made it easier to tell the animals apart
options.D: It showed whether some animals can detect color differences.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “They measured this by the ‘mirror test,’ which involved putting a colored mark on an ape’s body, and then showing the ape its reflection in a mirror. If the ape tried to remove the mark on its own body, the scientists knew that the ape was recognizing its reflection.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确提到，科学家通过在动物身上放置彩色标记，观察动物是否会试图去除自己身上的标记，以此判断动物是否能认出镜子中的自己。因此，放置标记的目的是帮助科学家判断动物是否具有自我识别能力，选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) It made it possible to track the animals’ movements. —— 错误，文中未提及 “追踪动物移动”，与标记的作用无关。 (B) It helped them determine whether the animals recognized themselves. —— 正确，与原文 “通过标记判断动物是否认出自己的倒影” 完全对应。 (C) It made it easier to tell the animals apart —— 错误，文中未提及 “区分动物”，标记的作用并非如此。 (D) It showed whether some animals can detect color differences. —— 错误，文中未涉及 “动物是否能识别颜色差异”，重点是自我识别。

questions.stem: According to the passage, all of the following are true about elephants EXCEPT:

options.A: They can recognize themselves in mirrors.
options.C: They possess qualities in common with apes.
options.D: They understand certain signs from other animals.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “elephants and dolphins have shown signs of self- recognition. These, like apes, are highly intelligent animals.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确提到大象能表现出自我识别的迹象（对应选项 A）、和类人猿一样是高智商动物（对应选项 B、C）；选项 D “它们能理解其他动物的某些信号” 在文中未提及，因此是例外选项。 选项分析： (A) They can recognize themselves in mirrors. —— 正确，文中明确提到大象有自我识别的迹象。 (B) They are highly intelligent animals. —— 正确，文中明确说明大象是高智商动物。 (C) They possess qualities in common with apes. —— 正确，大象和类人猿一样具有自我识别能力、都是高智商动物，有共同特质。 (D) They understand certain signs from other animals. —— 错误，文中未提及相关内容，无对应信息。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention cleaner fish?

options.A: To suggest that a wide range of animals may possess self-awareness
options.B: To imply that ocean animals are highly intelligent
options.C: To demonstrate a flaw in a recent experiment
options.D: To provide an example of an animal that does not recognize itself

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “But in a more recent experiment, a type of fish called the cleaner fish tried to scrape a mark off its body when it saw itself in the mirror. This suggests that even less intelligent animals may possess more self- awareness than previously suspected.” 正确答案分析： 作者前文提到类人猿、大象、海豚（高智商动物）能通过镜像测试，随后提到清洁鱼（相对不那么高智商的动物）也能表现出自我识别行为，目的是说明 “即使是智商较低的动物，也可能具有自我意识”，进而暗示 “更多种类的动物可能拥有自我意识”，选项 A 准确表达了这一目的。 选项分析： (A) To suggest that a wide range of animals may possess self-awareness —— 正确，符合原文 “清洁鱼的实验表明，即使不那么聪明的动物也可能有自我意识” 的逻辑，体现动物自我意识的广泛性。 (B) To imply that ocean animals are highly intelligent —— 错误，文中明确说清洁鱼是 “相对不那么聪明的动物”，并非暗示海洋动物高智商。 (C) To demonstrate a flaw in a recent experiment —— 错误，文中未提及实验有缺陷，反而认可实验结果带来的新发现。 (D) To provide an example of an animal that does not recognize itself —— 错误，清洁鱼试图去除身上的标记，说明它能识别自己，并非不能识别。
